query: Which survey items and experimental arms optimally measure perceived authenticity, elite-blame, purchase intent, and WTP for our A/B and conjoint designs?

response.query: Which survey items and experimental arms optimally measure perceived authenticity, elite-blame, purchase intent, and WTP for our A/B and conjoint designs?
response.answer: To measure perceived authenticity, use Likert scale items; for elite-blame, use open-ended questions; for purchase intent and WTP, use conjoint analysis and direct questions.
